verdict.rationale: Attio documents self-serve signup on a free tier meant for exploring 'on their own', real-time contact syncing and enrichment to bring in real data, and a Deal object an admin can enable and view as a kanban, which together suggest a self-built pipeline. However, nothing shows the time to a working pipeline, there is no documented spreadsheet or legacy-CRM import, and the homepage chat about migration describes vendor-assisted mapping rather than self-serve migration. missing for 10: evidence of time-to-value under an hour, a documented self-serve data import/migration path (CSV or CRM importer), a guided onboarding or pipeline-setup flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of setup without help.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: For individuals to explore Attio on their own.
Start today, no credit card required.
The Deal object is available in every Attio workspace, but disabled by default. It can only be activated by a workspace admin, in the objects settings page.
From kanbans to tables, visualize your data the way that works for you.
